description: Screenshot of an Associated Press news article dated January 7, 2019, headlined 'Ginsburg Missing Supreme Court Arguments for 1st Time'. It reports that Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg, 85, was missing oral arguments for the first time in more than 25 years while recuperating from December 21 surgery that removed two cancerous growths from her left lung, discovered while she was treated for ribs fractured in a November 7 fall.
text: Ginsburg Missing Supreme Court Arguments for 1st Time. By The Associated Press. Jan. 7, 2019. WASHINGTON — The Supreme Court says Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg is missing arguments for the first time in more than 25 years as she recuperates from cancer surgery last month. Court spokeswoman Kathy Arberg said Monday the 85-year-old Ginsburg is continuing to recuperate and work from home after doctors removed two cancerous growths from her left lung odn Dec. 21. Ginsburg was discharged from a New York hospital on Christmas day. Ginsburg had two earlier cancer surgeries in 1999 and 2009 that did not cause her to miss court sessions. She also has broken ribs on at least two occasions. The court said doctors found the growths on Ginsburg's lung when she was being treated for fractured ribs she suffered in a fall at her office on Nov. 7.
flags: Article text contains the typo 'odn Dec. 21' (transcribed verbatim)

description: Screenshot of Q drop #2653, tripcode Q !!mG7VJxZNCI, dated 6 Jan 2019, titled 'The History of Ruth Bader Ginsburg; Appointed by Bill Clinton'. The listed characterizations are the drop's claims; several (notably the age-of-consent item) have been widely disputed as misreadings of the report.
